law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, 2006 (Act No. 19 of 2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (corporate-owned and anonymous or pseudonymous works: 50 years from first publication; photographs: 50 years from making)
orphan_works: No orphan regime in 2006 Act; the 2025 Amendment Bill allowed licensing orphan works if the author is untraceable, and the Amendment Act (No. 8 of 2026, assented 29 Apr 2026) is reported to keep it (enacted text not checked)
digital_protection: 2006 Act silent on TPMs; the 2025 Amendment Bill (proposed s. 13B) prohibited circumventing TPMs and dealing in circumvention tools, with exceptions for security, education, research and print-disabled users; the Amendment Act (No. 8 of 2026) is reported to keep it (enacted text not checked)
fair_use_exceptions: Fair use (s. 15: private study, teaching, news reporting)
notes: Amended by the Copyright and Neighbouring Rights (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 8 of 2026), passed 17 Mar 2026 and assented 29 Apr 2026; reported published and in force 22 May 2026. The enacted text has not been checked: fields that depend on it say so
